[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[heading][size=3][color=#D4D4D8]
Elliott HD Portraits by Hemptress[/color][/size][/heading]
[color=#D4D4D8]This portrait makeover gives Elliott long, flowing auburn waves, striking teal eyes, a broader jaw, and a muscular build. He’s still your dramatic, book-loving romantic, just with a little more romance-cover energy. The man lives by the ocean and writes love stories. Let him look the part.[/color]


[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[heading][size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Installation with Portraiture[/color][/size][/heading]
[color=#D4D4D8]Let’s get your upgraded beach novelist into the game. 💚[/color]

[list=1]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Install [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/999]Portraiture[/url], choosing versions compatible with your game. [/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Download and unzip [b]Elliott HD Portraits by Hemptress[/b]. [/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Inside[/color]

[code]Stardew Valley/Mods/Portraiture/Portraits[/code][color=#D4D4D8], create a folder named[/color]

[code]Hemptress Elliott[/code][color=#D4D4D8]. [/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Place the portrait PNGs directly inside that folder. Portraiture loads portrait collections from these named subfolders.  [/color][/*]
[/list][color=#D4D4D8][b]Use these filenames:[/b][/color]

[table][tr][th][color=#D4D4D8]Portrait[/color][/th]
[th][color=#D4D4D8]Filename[/color][/th]
[/tr]
[tr][td][color=#D4D4D8]Everyday[/color][/td]
[td][code]Elliott.png[/code][/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td][color=#D4D4D8]Ginger Island beach[/color][/td]
[td][code]Elliott_IslandSouth.png[/code][/td]
[/tr]
[/table][color=#D4D4D8]The[/color]

[code]_IslandSouth[/code][color=#D4D4D8]naming convention is used for Portraiture’s island portraits.
Your everyday portrait’s full path should look like:[/color]


[code]Stardew Valley/Mods/Portraiture/Portraits/Hemptress Elliott/Elliott.png[/code]

[list=1]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Launch Stardew Valley through [b]SMAPI[/b]. [/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Talk to Elliott and press [b]P[/b] while his dialogue box is open until your new portraits appear. [/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Press [b]O[/b] to lock this portrait set to Elliott if you want to use different sets for other characters. [b]I[/b] switches between the regular portrait display and the larger portrait above the dialogue box. [/color][/*]
[/list]

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]

[color=#D4D4D8][b]What’s included:[/b][/color]

[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]HD everyday portraits[/b] featuring his burgundy coat, green cravat, and several expressions—from charming smiles to brooding looks. [/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Matching beach portraits[/b], because those shoulders deserved their own moment. [/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]A semi-realistic art style[/b] with detailed hair, expressive features, and transparent backgrounds.[/color][/*]
[/list]
